notes.title: Update 1.4
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce a new big update :) 

- Ported to Unity 5.1
- Support for more controllers
- Significantly reduced level loading times
- Disabled pause menu on level restart
- Dead players can't jump any more
- Fixed gaps between ground tiles
- Added achievements for the bosses.
- Fixe some crashes

Thanks for playing, you are awesome!

notes.title: First Release Candidate
notes.notes:
http://commander-cool.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/07/greenlit_2-580x231.png

Thanks for all your support. We got amazing feedback from players around the world. With the last update we have fixed many bugs and improved the gameplay dramatically. We think this version is now in a very good shape to go out of early access. The additional planned content will be available as a free update for everyone. With this decision we also stay at the current price point and not going to rise the price as planned.

Currently we working on the last improvements and planning to go out of early access in the coming weeks. The next small update will have some performance improvements and minor bug fixes.

Many people making custom maps for Commander Cool and we will include some of the best in the release version. So please looking forward to it.

We are thrilled to going out of early access and we hope everyone is excited too! :)

By the way, currently we are porting Commander Cool 2 for Xbox one!

notes.title: Update 1.2!
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce a new big update :)

Controls:
 - Rebinding for keyboard and controllers
 - Quick restart level (Default Select or R)
 - Switch between UI tabs on keyboard (Default 1 and 2 for left and right)

Mechanics:
 - Walljump and doublejump reworked
 - Enemies will always get knocked back on hit, depending on the force of your weapon
 
Level Selection
 - Is a fancy map now
 
Levels:
 - New tutoriallevel with cutscene!
 - Levels with fixed camera
 - Reworked most levels
 - New flying enemy
 - Reworked last boss
 - Two new bosslevels with a flying boss!
 
Bugfixes:
 - Player can no longer spawn before the map is loaded
 - Players will not switch controllers at random any more
 - Increased performance of large maps
 - Windows 32bit support
 
Common:
 - Reset save games
 - Reset leaderboards

Special Thanks to, added:
 - shieldgenerator7

http://commander-cool.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/10-580x326.jpg
